title: Closed-form fractional radial links for elliptical Mahalanobis discriminant analysis
abstract: arXiv:2607.06089v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study binary classification when the two classes are elliptical with a shared radial generator $g$. The log-likelihood ratio is then an additive function of the two squared Mahalanobis radii, with radial link $\varphi=\log g$. For Gaussian classes $\varphi$ is affine and the rule reduces to quadratic discriminant analysis (QDA); otherwise the Bayes link is not the identity. Instead of fitting this link with a spline smoother, we derive its family from the within-class law of the radius and estimate a finite fractional-power projection. We prove that the link is identifiable from the radius law, that the plug-in estimator is $\sqrt{n}$-consistent and asymptotically normal under finite-moment conditions, and that the induced classifier is asymptotically Bayes-optimal in an iterated sieve limit. For $d\ge2$ and non-nested class parameters, the identity link suffices only for affine (Gaussian) generators. The bridge, GAM members

translated_title: 椭圆马氏判别分析中的闭式分数次径向连接函数
translated_abstract: 我们研究两类均服从椭圆分布且共享径向生成函数 g 的二分类问题。此时对数似然比是两个平方马氏半径的加性函数，其径向连接为 φ=log g。对于高斯类，φ 是仿射函数，判别规则退化为二次判别分析（QDA）；否则贝叶斯连接并非恒等函数。不同于用样条平滑器拟合该连接，我们从类内半径分布推导出连接函数族，并估计一个有限的分数次幂投影。我们证明了该连接可由半径分布识别；在有限矩条件下，插入式估计量具有 √n 一致性与渐近正态性；且在迭代筛极限下，所得分类器渐近达到贝叶斯最优。对于 d≥2 且类参数非嵌套的情形，恒等连接仅在仿射（高斯）生成函数下才足够。（注：原文摘要末句似有截断）
tldr: 本文针对共享径向生成函数的椭圆分布两类分类问题，直接从类内半径分布推导出闭式分数次幂形式的径向连接函数，并证明了该连接的可识别性、估计量的√n一致性与渐近正态性，以及分类器的渐近贝叶斯最优性。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the radial link in closed-form fractional powers directly from the within-class radius law for binary classification of elliptical classes sharing a radial generator, proving its identifiability, the √n-consistency and asymptotic normality of the plug-in estimator, and the asymptotic Bayes-optimality of the resulting classifier.
